design_inputs.value: Fault-mode-explicit detection and post-fault remaining-time estimation on the rear motor inverter, using only signatures that are diagnostic by construction rather than control-tracking residuals: (1) gate-driver desaturation/short-circuit events on each phase (hardware-level, microsecond-scale fault evidence), (2) cross-checked phase current sensors and DC-link voltage dynamics to detect phase open/short and asymmetric conduction, and (3) online DC-link capacitor health from switching-frequency ripple current/voltage, giving ESR rise and capacitance fade — the established precursor signature for electrolytic DC-link failure. Once a fault is confirmed, remaining propulsion time is estimated from measured margin in the surviving power path: junction-temperature rise rate of the remaining devices and DC-link stored energy, extrapolated to the thermal/electrical shutdown threshold, producing an explicit countdown rather than a binary warning.

proposed_design.input: warnings must let the driver reach a safe pullover spot within the 10-15 seconds before the vehicle dies
proposed_design.mechanism: Fault-mode-explicit detection and post-fault remaining-time estimation on the rear motor inverter, using only signatures that are diagnostic by construction rather than control-tracking residuals: (1) gate-driver desaturation/short-circuit events on each phase (hardware-level, microsecond-scale fault evidence), (2) cross-checked phase current sensors and DC-link voltage dynamics to detect phase open/short and asymmetric conduction, and (3) online DC-link capacitor health from switching-frequency ripple current/voltage, giving ESR rise and capacitance fade — the established precursor signature for electrolytic DC-link failure. Once a fault is confirmed, remaining propulsion time is estimated from measured margin in the surviving power path: junction-temperature rise rate of the remaining devices and DC-link stored energy, extrapolated to the thermal/electrical shutdown threshold, producing an explicit countdown rather than a binary warning.
